LanguageData.RavenRelic_HojoAura.label: [Raven] Hojo Cube Gospel
LanguageData.RavenRelic_HojoAura.description: An eerie wave emanating from the Hojo Golden Cube. The faint "hoooo" sound unexpectedly stimulates deep physiological vitality, making one become extremely excited without noticing, not only greatly enhancing satisfaction during recreation, but also astonishingly strengthening the desire and capacity for reproduction.
LanguageData.RavenRelic_EasterEggAura.label: [Raven] Otherworldly Boon
LanguageData.RavenRelic_EasterEggAura.description: A transcendent aura radiating from a crossover relic. The wondrous bond crossing world-lines allows those bathed in the halo to more easily comprehend the unknown, and exudes an indescribable unique charm in social situations. This is a silent protection from otherworldly allies.
LanguageData.RavenRelic_OperatorSecretAura.label: [Raven] Secret Fragrance Whisper
LanguageData.RavenRelic_OperatorSecretAura.descriptio: A mysterious fragrance lingering on Zuo Yao's intimate garments. This complex scent mingled with a maiden's body scent can greatly soothe tense nerves, significantly reducing the risk of mental breakdown; at the same time, it can also provoke a powerful reproductive urge.
